_meta.description: Sovereign Story Engine — Master Archetype Reference Image Library
_meta.purpose: Character consistency anchors for Grok Imagine API image-to-image pipeline. Layer 6 (Imagination Engine) and Character Consistency Manager read from this file.
_meta.art_style: Fantasy illustration, painterly style, warm muted palette, soft lighting, no text, high detail, atmospheric

warriors.description: Characters who lead with strength, combat, and direct confrontation as defense

archetypes.name: Warrior Princess
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The wall protects but also imprisons
archetypes.visual_description: Full ornate plate armor head to toe, helm hiding most of face, sword held point-down defensively, arms crossed over hilt, gaze averted sideways, misty forest backdrop
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Completely encased in ornate armor, beauty hidden behind metal, sword defensive not aggressive, identity obscured by helm

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, bold heroic composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted silvers, deep steel blues, warm amber mist accents
visual_style.lighting: dramatic rim lighting through dense fog
visual_style.mood: fierce, guarded, defiant
visual_style.atmosphere: misty dark forest edge, towering trees half-lost in fog, silence before battle

archetypes.name: Gladiator
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Fighting because it's the only language learned
archetypes.visual_description: Full helm hiding face, shield raised covering torso, sword low, kneeling not standing, fortress and distant army behind, muted earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Face completely hidden behind helm, kneeling not standing, shield covering core, arena is only world known

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, ground-level heroic composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted earth tones, dusty bronze, weathered iron gray
visual_style.lighting: overcast battlefield light with warm breaks through clouds
visual_style.mood: battle-worn, kneeling, weary resolve
visual_style.atmosphere: vast fortress plains, distant armies in fog, arena dust settling

archetypes.name: Amazon
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Self-reliance as survival, learning to accept help
archetypes.visual_description: Hooded face in shadow, spear held upright, bow undrawn at hip, shoulder armor, standing among overgrown jungle ruins, warm green tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Armed for every scenario but hasn't engaged, hood hides identity, multiple weapons as over-preparation

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, jungle-depth layered composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm greens, vine-draped gold, shadow-dappled amber
visual_style.lighting: filtered jungle canopy light, warm shafts through leaves
visual_style.mood: self-reliant, distant, quietly defiant
visual_style.atmosphere: overgrown jungle ruins reclaimed by nature, ancient stone and vine

archetypes.name: Samurai
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Duty without self-compassion is another cage
archetypes.visual_description: Full ceremonial armor with kabuto helmet, face entirely masked, katana drawn but held low across body, rigid formal posture, bamboo forest, dark muted palette
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Face entirely masked, rigid formal posture, discipline as total identity concealment, no human skin visible

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, formal ceremonial composition
visual_style.color_palette: dark muted indigo, lacquer red accents, bamboo green-gray
visual_style.lighting: cold diffused forest light through bamboo, no direct sun
visual_style.mood: rigid, disciplined, identity through structure
visual_style.atmosphere: silent bamboo forest, ceremonial stillness, duty-weight in the air

archetypes.name: Shield Bearer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The shield protects but prevents embrace
archetypes.visual_description: Full plate armor, closed helm, massive ornate shield covering entire front, no face visible, fog erasing all context, muted silvers and golds
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Most armored image in entire library, pure defense, the shield IS the identity, zero humanity visible

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, fortress-scale monumental composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted silvers, burnished golds, cold fog white
visual_style.lighting: diffused overcast, metallic reflections in fog
visual_style.mood: absolute defense, identity as barrier, immovable
visual_style.atmosphere: fog-erased battlefield, no context visible, the shield IS the world

archetypes.name: Dragon Slayer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Slaying vs making peace — only one works
archetypes.visual_description: Blood-stained armor, sword raised, helm closed, dragon looming in fog behind, green hills, warm muted palette with red accents
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Already wounded from fighting, dragon isn't defeated — still looming, blood on armor shows cost of the fight

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, action-tension composition
visual_style.color_palette: blood-stained bronze, warm amber, fog-muted red accents
visual_style.lighting: overcast with ember-glow from dragon presence
visual_style.mood: restless, channeling pain into action, wounded but fighting
visual_style.atmosphere: green hills under gathering fog, dragon silhouette looming, cost of battle visible

archetypes.name: Knight (Meadow)
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Beauty surrounds but armor prevents feeling it
archetypes.visual_description: Full plate, great helm completely sealed, sword planted in ground, standing in wildflower meadow, rusted armor, warm golden fog
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Beauty surrounds but knight can't feel through armor, rust shows cost of staying sealed, helm completely closed in a gentle environment

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, contrast of armor in beauty
visual_style.color_palette: warm golden fog, wildflower colors muted by rust, meadow greens
visual_style.lighting: golden hour warmth filtering around cold armor
visual_style.mood: surrounded by beauty, unable to feel it, sealed off
visual_style.atmosphere: wildflower meadow in golden fog, rust and petals, beauty unregistered

archetypes.name: Viking
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Strength that protects vs strength that destroys
archetypes.visual_description: Heavy leather and plate armor, fur pelts, braided hair, axe held low behind back, facing away toward the sea, coastal cliffs, muted earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Turned away from viewer, axe behind back not raised, ocean represents emotional depth he won't face

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, coastal epic composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted earth tones, sea-gray, fur-brown, cold steel
visual_style.lighting: cold northern coastal light, overcast ocean horizon
visual_style.mood: stoic, turned away, emotional depth refused
visual_style.atmosphere: coastal cliffs above churning sea, the ocean as unexamined emotion

archetypes.name: Knight (Forest)
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Contemplating whether the weapon is still needed
archetypes.visual_description: Scale mail, cloak, sword held out examining it, head bowed, alone in misty autumn forest, warm muted browns and golds
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Quietest warrior image, introspection before next fight, examining the sword rather than wielding it

visual_style.art_direction: dramatic painterly illustration, quiet introspective composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm muted browns, autumn golds, cloak-gray
visual_style.lighting: soft diffused autumn forest light, warm and contemplative
visual_style.mood: contemplative, paused, examining the weapon
visual_style.atmosphere: misty autumn forest, fallen leaves, the quietest warrior moment

guardians.description: Characters who protect, watch over, and maintain boundaries for others

archetypes.name: Castle Keeper
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Holding the keys but afraid to open the gate
archetypes.visual_description: Plate armor, keys hanging from belt, one hand on gate door, gaze turned away not through opening, light pouring in from behind, castle gate setting
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Gate cracked open but blocking it with his body, holds keys to let people in but hasn't decided to open

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, threshold framing composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm gold light against cold stone gray, iron key tones
visual_style.lighting: warm light pouring through cracked gate, cold stone shadows
visual_style.mood: watchful, protective, torn between opening and guarding
visual_style.atmosphere: castle gate threshold, light beyond, weight of the keys

archetypes.name: Lighthouse Keeper
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Keeping the light burning for others while standing alone in the storm
archetypes.visual_description: Armor under cloak, lantern held out into storm, head bowed, waves crashing, lighthouse looming above, dark stormy palette with warm lantern glow
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Caretaking at personal cost, lantern is small against the dark, standing in the storm himself

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, storm-against-warmth composition
visual_style.color_palette: dark storm grays, warm lantern gold, wave-white
visual_style.lighting: warm lantern glow cutting through storm darkness
visual_style.mood: selfless, worn, keeping light alive at personal cost
visual_style.atmosphere: storm-battered cliff, lighthouse above, waves crashing, small warmth in vast dark

archetypes.name: Watchwoman
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Vigilance as identity — who are you when you stop watching?
archetypes.visual_description: Armor under dark cloak, lantern held over parapet, gaze down into fog below, castle towers fading into mist behind, dark muted palette
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Watching for threats that may never come, castle wall IS the boundary between self and world

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, high vantage atmospheric composition
visual_style.color_palette: dark muted blues, fog white, warm lantern amber accent
visual_style.lighting: warm lantern glow above cold fog, parapet shadows
visual_style.mood: alert, vigilant, identity as watchfulness
visual_style.atmosphere: castle parapet above fog, towers fading into mist, watching for what may never come

archetypes.name: Sentinel
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The post was never relieved — who said you had to stay?
archetypes.visual_description: Full helm, cracked weathered armor, spear and shield, standing in narrow mountain pass, face completely hidden, worn earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Armor old and worn from standing too long, the post was never relieved, guarding passage between two worlds

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, narrow pass monumental composition
visual_style.color_palette: worn earth tones, cracked stone gray, weathered iron
visual_style.lighting: cold mountain pass light, no warmth source
visual_style.mood: steadfast, worn, duty above self, unrelieved
visual_style.atmosphere: narrow mountain pass between two worlds, the post was never relieved

archetypes.name: Gatekeeper
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Protecting what's sacred by never entering it yourself
archetypes.visual_description: Hooded robes over ornate armor, key-staff held upright, standing centered in glowing archway, face shadowed, forest behind, warm golden arch light
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Blocking and protecting threshold simultaneously, light behind but facing outward into forest, protecting sacred space by never entering

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, sacred threshold composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm golden arch light, forest shadow green, ornate silver
visual_style.lighting: warm sacred glow from archway behind, forest dark ahead
visual_style.mood: reverent, guarding sacred space, facing outward into darkness
visual_style.atmosphere: glowing archway in ancient forest, sacred space protected by never entering

archetypes.name: Guardian Angel
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Protecting something precious but won't show it or let go
archetypes.visual_description: Shoulder armor, wings spread but curved inward protectively, arms crossed over chest holding something close, head bowed, eyes down, warm muted light
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Wings could carry anywhere but standing still, holding something precious against chest, protecting not soaring

visual_style.art_direction: protective painterly illustration, sweeping vertical wing composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm muted gold and white, feather-soft ivory, gentle amber
visual_style.lighting: soft diffused warm light from above, gentle and embracing
visual_style.mood: selfless, protective, holding something precious, grounded not soaring
visual_style.atmosphere: open sky meeting warm earth, wings as shelter not flight

explorers.description: Characters who seek, wander, and maintain freedom through movement and distance

archetypes.name: Pathfinder
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The map is the illusion of control — the territory is the truth
archetypes.visual_description: Shoulder armor, sword at side, studying a map with furrowed brow, kneeling in thick brush, gaze down at map not ahead, misty overgrown forest
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Has a plan but doesn't trust it, the map is the illusion of control, forest denser than the map shows

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, ground-level discovery composition
visual_style.color_palette: mossy greens, parchment tan, misty forest gray
visual_style.lighting: filtered forest canopy light, map-reading intimacy
visual_style.mood: analytical, controlled, trusting the plan but doubting the territory
visual_style.atmosphere: thick overgrown forest, kneeling in brush, map as illusion of control

archetypes.name: Nomad
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Always ready to move because staying means being found
archetypes.visual_description: Layered wraps and shoulder plate armor, walking beside loaded horse, wary direct gaze, dwelling fading in fog behind, steppe landscape, muted earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Left home but keeps looking back, horse carries everything owned, always ready to move

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, journey-road composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted earth tones, steppe gold, travel-worn brown
visual_style.lighting: overcast steppe light, dwelling fading in fog behind
visual_style.mood: restless, always ready to move, looking back while leaving
visual_style.atmosphere: vast steppe landscape, dwelling disappearing in fog, loaded horse beside

archetypes.name: Rogue
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Learning that needing someone is not weakness
archetypes.visual_description: Full dark armor under hooded cloak, sword sheathed, face shadowed, overlooking city at sunset from rooftop, muted warm tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Above the city not in it, watching from the edge, the hood is the wall, counter-dependence visualized

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, elevated urban vantage composition
visual_style.color_palette: dark leather tones, warm sunset amber, rooftop shadow
visual_style.lighting: warm sunset against dark silhouette, city below
visual_style.mood: self-reliant, above the world, choosing isolation as safety
visual_style.atmosphere: city rooftop at sunset, above the crowd not among it, hood as wall

archetypes.name: Cartographer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Mapping the world as substitute for experiencing it
archetypes.visual_description: Plate armor, sword on back, hunched over compass and half-drawn map, quill in hand, seated among ruins, warm muted palette
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Documenting world instead of entering it, intellectualization through documentation, ruins say old map failed

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, intimate study-amid-ruins composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm muted amber, parchment cream, ruin-stone gray
visual_style.lighting: warm ambient light on instruments, ruins in soft background
visual_style.mood: analytical, documenting instead of experiencing
visual_style.atmosphere: ancient ruins, compass and half-drawn map, intellectualization through documentation

archetypes.name: Scout
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Safety through distance — what happens when you come down from the mountain?
archetypes.visual_description: Camouflage-patterned armor, hooded, crouching at cliff edge, gaze outward across forest canopy, mountain overlook, muted earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Sees far but stays hidden, elevated position is safety through distance, observing world from above not within

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, elevated observation composition
visual_style.color_palette: camouflage earth tones, mountain gray, distant forest green
visual_style.lighting: natural overcast mountain light, distance clarity
visual_style.mood: hidden, elevated, safety through distance
visual_style.atmosphere: cliff edge mountain overlook, vast forest canopy below, observing not participating

archetypes.name: Ranger
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Stillness is not entrapment
archetypes.visual_description: Green hooded cloak, white armor underneath, bow held but undrawn, face hidden in shadow, standing among undergrowth, misty forest greens
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Armed and capable but frozen between trees, forest is both home and cage

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, forest stillness composition
visual_style.color_palette: misty forest greens, white armor accent, shadow-dappled brown
visual_style.lighting: soft filtered green forest light, misty diffusion
visual_style.mood: frozen, capable but still, forest as both home and cage
visual_style.atmosphere: deep misty forest undergrowth, bow held but undrawn, stillness is not entrapment

archetypes.name: Wanderer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The destination is visible but the journey requires presence
archetypes.visual_description: Shoulder armor, tattered cloak, staff in hand, pack on back, facing away toward distant ruin on horizon, path visible through fog, golden hills
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Most hopeful explorer image, goal visible but fog between here and there is the therapeutic work

visual_style.art_direction: expansive painterly illustration, path-to-horizon hopeful composition
visual_style.color_palette: golden hills, fog-silver, tattered cloak brown
visual_style.lighting: warm golden light on distant horizon, fog between here and there
visual_style.mood: hopeful, determined, fog as therapeutic work ahead
visual_style.atmosphere: golden hills with path through fog toward distant destination, most hopeful explorer

mystics.description: Characters who seek meaning through spiritual, esoteric, or transcendent practice

archetypes.name: Shaman
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The ancestors are present but the shaman isn't ready to face them
archetypes.visual_description: Feather headdress and armor bracers, drum held close to chest, eyes closed, head bowed, spirit figures in fog behind, dark forest, warm muted tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Drum held like a shield not raised to play, spirit figures present in fog but not faced, eyes closed

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, spirit-world layered composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm muted earth tones, feather-brown, spirit-fog white
visual_style.lighting: soft forest twilight, spirit figures glowing faintly in fog
visual_style.mood: reverent, unready, ancestors present but unfaced
visual_style.atmosphere: dark forest spirit gathering, drum held like shield, fog between worlds

archetypes.name: Seer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Seeing truth but not ready to name it
archetypes.visual_description: Blindfolded, shoulder armor under draped robes, third eye faintly glowing above cloth, hands open reaching hesitantly, seated among temple ruins, starlit sky
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Blindfold is chosen not imposed, insight as defense against having to act on what's seen, hands reaching but not grasping

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, sacred ruins starlit composition
visual_style.color_palette: deep indigo, starlit silver, faint third-eye glow
visual_style.lighting: starlit sky above temple ruins, subtle inner glow
visual_style.mood: knowing, blindfolded by choice, insight as defense
visual_style.atmosphere: temple ruins under starlit sky, truth visible but unnamed

archetypes.name: Healer
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Healing others to avoid healing self
archetypes.visual_description: Hooded, runic bracers as armor, hands glowing faintly over flowers, gaze down at the healing not at anyone, alone in meadow field, warm orange and gold tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Glow is for the flowers not for herself, hood says 'don't look at me, look at what I can do for you'

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, intimate healing light composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm orange and gold, meadow green, healing-glow white
visual_style.lighting: soft golden hour with faint healing luminescence
visual_style.mood: selfless, hidden behind the work, healing others to avoid self
visual_style.atmosphere: solitary meadow field, healing glow over flowers, hood as deflection

archetypes.name: Sage
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Wisdom without vulnerability is isolation
archetypes.visual_description: Hooded, layered shoulder armor, glowing book held closed against chest, seated within ancient tree roots, gaze down into book, misty forest
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Knowledge as shelter, tree is the fortress, reading alone, book holds answers but won't share them

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, ancient wisdom den composition
visual_style.color_palette: misty forest green, aged wood brown, glowing book amber
visual_style.lighting: glowing book illumination in dark forest hollow
visual_style.mood: wise, isolated, knowledge as shelter
visual_style.atmosphere: ancient tree roots forming natural study, book as fortress, reading alone

archetypes.name: Druid
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Connecting through the body before the mind — can they face the therapist directly?
archetypes.visual_description: Veiled, antler crown, bark-scale armor on arms, hand pressed flat against ancient tree, face hidden behind veil and branches, oak grove, warm earthy tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Touching the source but won't show face, tree is the therapist, connecting through body not eyes

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, nature-merged organic composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm earthy tones, bark brown, veil-white, antler bone
visual_style.lighting: soft dappled oak grove light, warm and grounding
visual_style.mood: body-connected, grounded through physical contact, veiled
visual_style.atmosphere: ancient oak grove, hand on tree, connecting through body not words

archetypes.name: Monk
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Is faith a fortress or a meadow?
archetypes.visual_description: Layered shoulder armor under white robes, prayer beads gripped tightly in both hands, eyes closed, head bowed, seated in stillness, warm light, monastery setting
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Beads held like a lifeline, spiritual practice as containment, discipline as structure holding self together

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, meditative stillness composition
visual_style.color_palette: white robes, warm golden light, prayer-bead amber
visual_style.lighting: warm monastery light, soft and embracing stillness
visual_style.mood: reverent, contained, spiritual practice as structure
visual_style.atmosphere: monastery of stillness, prayer beads as lifeline, discipline holding self together

archetypes.name: Oracle
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The gift is present but not yet trusted
archetypes.visual_description: Veiled, ornate forearm armor, crystal held in lap, head bowed over crystal, candlelit temple chamber, seated alone, warm amber and teal tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Studying light in private, veil says vision is for oracle alone, not ready to share what's seen

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, luminous sacred detail, veiled intimacy
visual_style.color_palette: warm amber, deep teal, candlelight gold, crystal prismatic
visual_style.lighting: candlelit interior glow, crystal refractions on stone
visual_style.mood: mysterious, contemplative, gift present but untrusted
visual_style.atmosphere: ancient temple chamber, incense haze, crystal light on walls, vision kept private

archetypes.name: Alchemist
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Transmutation as isolation — turning pain into something useful alone
archetypes.visual_description: Hooded, shoulder plate armor, face shadowed, hunched over glowing flasks on workbench, gloved hands carefully pouring, forest ruins, warm amber glow
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Working alone in the dark, hood and gloves say 'don't touch me while I work', transmutation as isolation

visual_style.art_direction: ethereal painterly illustration, workshop-glow intimate composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm amber glow, bronze flask, dark forest shadow
visual_style.lighting: warm amber glow from alchemical flasks in dark workshop
visual_style.mood: isolated, transmuting pain into something useful, alone in the dark
visual_style.atmosphere: forest ruin workshop, glowing flasks, transmutation as isolation

nature.description: Characters who identify with natural elements, landscapes, and organic forces

archetypes.name: Wolf
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The lone wolf survives but doesn't live — the pack is the healing
archetypes.visual_description: Thick fur with armor-like scale plating on shoulders and back, alert stance on hilltop, head watchful but not aggressive, distant wolf silhouette in fog, misty pine forest, muted browns and golds
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Pack exists in distance but hasn't joined, surviving alone by choice, armor-like markings suggest natural defense

visual_style.art_direction: naturalistic painterly illustration, lone-against-pack composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted browns and golds, pine-forest green, fog-silver
visual_style.lighting: soft misty pine forest light, dawn diffusion
visual_style.mood: alert, self-reliant, pack exists but unchosen
visual_style.atmosphere: misty pine forest hilltop, distant wolf silhouette in fog, surviving alone

archetypes.name: Wildflower
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Beautiful but can't feel the ground — can she land?
archetypes.visual_description: Petal-like dress figure with vine armor patterns on torso, arms wrapped inward, head slightly bowed, face turned away, backlit in sun-dappled meadow, muted golds and whites
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Armor woven into body itself, defenses so integrated person doesn't know they're wearing them, present but not fully embodied

visual_style.art_direction: soft watercolor illustration, organic flowing forms, dreamy diffusion
visual_style.color_palette: sun-faded golds, petal whites, meadow sage greens
visual_style.lighting: soft diffused backlight through petals, sun-dappled warmth
visual_style.mood: gentle, ethereal, present but not fully embodied
visual_style.atmosphere: sun-dappled meadow, petal-strewn breeze, defenses woven into the body itself

archetypes.name: Storm Rider
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: The storm hasn't arrived yet — will you face it or flee?
archetypes.visual_description: Green cloak over light armor, standing on cliff edge, cloak whipping in wind, defensive bracing posture, storm clouds gathering distantly, muted earth tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Storm gathering but distant, bracing not charging, feet planted but body language reads as preparing not confronting

visual_style.art_direction: naturalistic painterly illustration, approaching-storm dramatic composition
visual_style.color_palette: muted earth tones, storm-cloud gray, wind-whipped green
visual_style.lighting: storm-filtered dramatic light, pre-storm electricity
visual_style.mood: bracing, anticipatory, storm gathering but not yet arrived
visual_style.atmosphere: cliff edge before gathering storm, wind-whipped cloak, bracing not charging

archetypes.name: Mountain Climber
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Maximum gear for minimum trust — what if the mountain is friendlier than you think?
archetypes.visual_description: Heavy layered gear with rope and armor plates, ice axe held defensively at side, headgear and scarf covering face, cautious sideways gaze, steep crystal mountain slope, warm amber against cold crystals
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Heaviest armor in nature set, over-preparation as defense, crystals tie to Crystal Mountains biome, hasn't reached summit

visual_style.art_direction: naturalistic painterly illustration, vertical ascent composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm amber against cold crystal blue, heavy gear earth tones
visual_style.lighting: cold crystal mountain ambient with warm body heat glow
visual_style.mood: over-prepared, cautious, trust deficit, not yet at summit
visual_style.atmosphere: steep crystal mountain slope, heaviest gear in nature set, crystals glowing around

archetypes.name: Tree Keeper
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Safety through becoming invisible within nature — the tree is the safe attachment
archetypes.visual_description: Bark-patterned skin merging with tree, ivy-leaf cloak as natural armor, head bowed, eyes closed, pressing into ancient oak protectively, misty deep forest, warm earthy tones
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Defenses literally becoming part of environment, embrace is protective not relaxed, can't let go of the tree yet

visual_style.art_direction: soft organic illustration, figure-merging-with-nature composition
visual_style.color_palette: warm earthy tones, bark brown, ivy green, moss soft
visual_style.lighting: deep forest filtered light, warm and ancient
visual_style.mood: grounded, invisible within nature, tree as safe attachment
visual_style.atmosphere: deep misty forest, figure becoming part of ancient oak, embrace protective not relaxed

archetypes.name: Garden Tender
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Healing the garden instead of healing self
archetypes.visual_description: Earth-toned robes with light protective bracers at wrists, kneeling among herbs and flowers, head bowed, hands reaching toward plants, misty garden valley, warm subdued colors
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Tending plants not people, flowers not yet in full bloom, nurturing but inward-focused

visual_style.art_direction: soft watercolor illustration, intimate garden-level composition
visual_style.color_palette: earth tones, herb green, warm subdued flower colors
visual_style.lighting: soft valley garden light, warm and nurturing
visual_style.mood: nurturing, inward-focused, healing garden instead of self
visual_style.atmosphere: misty garden valley, herbs and flowers, kneeling among growing things

archetypes.name: River Walker
archetypes.therapeutic_direction: Untapped emotional depth — not yet trusting own capacity
archetypes.visual_description: Light armor at shoulder under flowing robes, wading in misty river, swirling blue-white energy around legs, head bowed, gaze downward at water, warm golden backlight
archetypes.early_stage_markers: Magic happening around but not being directed, horizon obscured by mist, no visible destination, hasn't turned to face the light behind

visual_style.art_direction: soft watercolor illustration, flowing water luminous composition
visual_style.color_palette: blue-white swirling energy, warm golden backlight, river silver
